summary: Iteration 4 (OTP + 3-role rewrite) tested end-to-end. Backend: 32/32 pytest cases pass — OTP rate-limit 429, invalid-role 400, verify-otp missing-code 400, /me shape (mobile/name/role/status/no email), logout, role guards (consumer 403 on /products/mine|/ai|/admin, pending admin 403 on /products/mine writes AND on GET /mine, approved admin OK, super_admin OK), new SKU model (primary/secondary/brand/company/place/quantity_value/quantity_unit/images/video_url/search_keywords + auto discount_percent + you_save), /products/tree returns all 9 primary + >=15 secondary categories, Hinglish search (soap→3, atta→2+, tel→3 oils, आटा Devanagari→atta, chai→tea/sugar), cart shape (mrp_total/savings/savings_percent/line_mrp/line_savings/min_order=5000/fees=0), checkout <5000 blocked / >=5000 success with delivery_otp, super-admin approvals (list + approve + cannot-modify-super-admin 400 + invalid-status 400), upload/image returns data:image/png;base64 URL. Frontend: Landing has MonthlyMart logo + Upto 20% badge + 4-hour delivery card + ₹5,000 min-order + Sign in + I'm an admin, no 'zopin' text, title stays 'MonthlyMart · Monthly Groceries Delivered Home'. Login /login has Consumer|Admin tabs, +91 prefix, Send OTP btn. Consumer /shop: 9-tile category grid, purple hero, Hinglish search proven (soap→Dove+Lifebuoy+Santoor, tel→Fortune Oil, आटा→Atta results). Cart shows 'You'll save ₹1206 on this order' green banner + Save-per-line + FREE delivery + FREE platform fee. Pending admin sees amber 'Your admin account is pending approval' banner and Add-SKU button is disabled; no Admin Approvals nav for pending admin. Super Admin sidebar shows Admin Approvals; /admin/approvals lists Shashank as Super Admin + pending TEST_AdminPending row with Approve/Reject buttons. Approved admin Inventory Add-SKU dialog has ALL required fields (Primary/Secondary category, Brand, Company, Place, MRP, Discount, Search keywords, Photos w/ file upload+URL, Video w/ file upload+URL, AI generate) — 2 file inputs, 1 datalist for secondary suggestions.

minor.issue: Stale unique index 'email_1' on users collection (leftover from previous email-based schema) blocked any new OTP-signup because the OTP flow inserts users without an 'email' field → MongoDB DuplicateKeyError. Dropped it manually to unblock tests. seed_super_admin / startup should DROP the legacy email_1 index once (or handle the migration explicitly) so real consumer/admin OTP signups do not fail with 500.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL RUNTIME ERROR on /checkout: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toFixed)'. The initial empty cart is {items:[], subtotal:0, delivery_fee:0, platform_fee:0, total:0} — it does NOT include mrp_total, savings, savings_percent. Checkout.js calls cart.mrp_total.toFixed(2), cart.savings.toFixed(2), cart.savings_percent immediately on first render (before the async refresh() completes), which throws and shows the red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay. Fix: either (a) extend the 'empty' const in CartContext.js to include mrp_total:0, savings:0, savings_percent:0, or (b) use (cart.mrp_total||0).toFixed(2) etc. defensively in Checkout.js. Also affects Cart.js if user hits it mid-load, but Cart.js seems to guard already.

action_items: (HIGH) Fix Checkout.js crash — add mrp_total:0, savings:0, savings_percent:0 to the 'empty' cart default in /app/frontend/src/context/CartContext.js, OR guard every cart.X.toFixed() call in Checkout.js with (cart.X || 0).toFixed(...).

(MEDIUM) Drop legacy 'email_1' unique index in seed_super_admin() (or on startup) — otherwise every fresh OTP signup blows up with a 500 DuplicateKey error the first time a real user tries to sign up on a machine that was previously running the email-based build.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py::normalize_mobile correctly handles bare 10-digit, 91-prefixed 12-digit, 0-prefixed 11-digit, and already-plus-prefixed input. JWT payload carries role+status so downstream cookie/Bearer flows work.
auth_routes.send_otp rate-limit is per-mobile within 5 min, blocks 4th (count>=3) with 429 — matches spec.
auth_routes.verify_otp: for a new mobile, auto-approves consumer, marks admin as pending. Existing users' role/status untouched (super admin cannot be demoted via a stray OTP).
product_routes._product_out auto-computes discount_percent and you_save; strips MongoDB _id.

product_routes._build_search_regex ORs across name/brand/company/primary_category/secondary_category/description/short_description/place/search_keywords — enables Hinglish and Devanagari search out of the box.
cart_routes returns full pricing envelope (mrp_total, subtotal, savings, savings_percent, min_order, delivery_fee=0, platform_fee=0, line_mrp, line_savings) — good.
order_routes.checkout enforces MIN_ORDER=5000, generates 4-digit delivery_otp, computes 5% GST, persists savings snapshot in the order doc — good.
admin_routes.update_admin_status blocks modifying super_admin (400) and requires target to be an admin (400 otherwise) — good.
upload_routes uses base64 data-URL for photos+video; require_current_user (any authenticated) — reasonable for MVP but should move to signed S3/object-storage before scale.
CartContext.empty is missing mrp_total/savings/savings_percent — the root cause of the /checkout crash listed above.
seed_super_admin does NOT drop the legacy email_1 unique index; if any prior deployment ran the email-schema, brand-new OTP signups fail on that box.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — landing, login, consumer /shop w/ Hinglish search, cart, admin pending banner, super-admin approvals, admin Inventory Add-SKU dialog all verified; /checkout crashes on first render

rca of the issue: Checkout crash — CartContext initial state is {items:[], subtotal:0, delivery_fee:0, platform_fee:0, total:0}. React renders Checkout.js synchronously before useEffect→refresh() populates the cart. Checkout.js line 105 does cart.mrp_total.toFixed(2) — mrp_total is undefined → TypeError. Repro: 1) log in as consumer with cookie 2) navigate directly to /checkout — red overlay appears immediately before any network request. Fix (1 line): change 'const empty = {...}' in CartContext.js to include mrp_total:0, savings:0, savings_percent:0. Stale index — a previous iteration of the app used {email, password} auth with a unique index on email. When the schema switched to mobile-only, the index remained. Any new user doc created via verify_otp (no email field → email=null) collides with the pre-existing null-email super-admin doc that was migrated in place. On my test machine I saw this immediately. Fix: on startup, try/except db.users.drop_index('email_1').
